Terms & Conditions

Please read these terms carefully before placing an order with Estilo.

Last updated: August 2026

01

Acceptance of Terms

By placing an order or using Estilo, you (the Customer) are deemed to have accepted all terms and conditions listed here. We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Customers are advised to review them before each order.

02

Products & Orders

All custom orders require a minimum order quantity (MOQ) as specified on each product page. Orders are confirmed only after successful payment. Design and artwork approvals must be given in writing or via WhatsApp/email before production begins. Estilo is not responsible for errors in artwork provided by the customer.

03

Pricing & Taxes

All prices are listed in Indian Rupees (INR). Prices include applicable GST (5%, 12%, 18%, or 28%) based on product category. Estilo is fully GST compliant. Shipping charges, if applicable, are displayed at checkout. Prices may change without prior notice.

04

Payment

We accept UPI, debit/credit cards, and net banking via Razorpay. For partial payment orders, the remaining balance must be paid at the time of delivery. Non-payment of the outstanding amount may result in order cancellation, return, and account suspension. Partial payment advances are non-refundable.

05

Delivery

Orders placed before 2 PM are processed within 48–72 hours. Delivery typically takes 4–10 working days depending on your location. Estilo is not liable for delays caused by incorrect delivery addresses, public holidays, natural disasters, government restrictions, or courier policies. Rejected or undelivered orders returned to us may still be chargeable.

06

No Return Policy

As all products are customized with your logo or artwork, no returns or exchanges are accepted. Orders cannot be cancelled after production begins. Change requests may be accommodated within 2 working hours of order placement, but are not guaranteed. Refer to our Cancellation & Refund Policy for replacement eligibility.

07

Intellectual Property

You warrant that any artwork, logos, or designs you provide are owned by you or that you hold proper rights or licenses to use them for printing. Estilo is not responsible for any copyright or trademark infringement arising from customer-provided artwork. Estilo has no affiliation with any third-party brands.

08

Limitation of Liability

Estilo's liability is limited to the value of the purchased product. We are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, consequential losses, or any mismatch in quality expectations beyond manufacturing defects. The service is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind beyond what is stated.

09

Governing Law & Jurisdiction

These terms are governed by the laws of India. All disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts in India. Customers agree to resolve disputes through mutual discussion before approaching legal forums.

10

Contact

Customer Support: WhatsApp or contact form (link below). Working hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM. For order-related queries, always mention your Order ID (e.g. MPC0001).
